$comment: Studio page data. Helm's Studio tab writes this file; it can also be edited by hand. items[] stays EMPTY until real posts are approved. Schema: items[] = {platform: youtube|twitch|tiktok|instagram|odysee|discord, id, title, topic: uu-devlog|ai-helm-owls|gaming-modding|drone-hardware, date: YYYY-MM-DD, thumb: https URL or empty (YouTube derives it from id), url: https link, kind: video|short|post}. channels[]: one row per account (many per platform are fine); an empty url renders as 'coming soon'. schedule[]: {day, time (24h), tz (IANA, e.g. Europe/Riga), title, platform}. Example item: {"platform":"youtube","id":"VIDEO_ID_11","title":"UU devlog #1","topic":"uu-devlog","date":"2026-10-25","thumb":"","url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID_11","kind":"video"}
